snippet.title: The Doors to the Castle of Secrets Are Officially Open
snippet.description:
Are you ready to enter the castle?

Step into a world of hidden truths, twisted puzzles, and dark secrets waiting to be uncovered. Your journey begins now.

Play Castle of Secrets, available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825110/Castle_of_Secrets/
